identity: Complete canonical GameSession record including ruleset_fingerprint and complete action history; no normalization that could hide exact collisions.
purpose: Root-sampler feasibility only; no training, model fitting, or outcomes.
question: Can a deterministic reserved family-ID pool provide at least 16 unique, exact full-rule/history evaluation roots per rule, disjoint from every potential 4-ply training-family root?
selection: For each rule, scan candidate family IDs ascending; accept the first 16 legal, nonterminal, full-4-ply roots whose exact canonical GameSession record is absent from the complete 512-family training set and earlier accepted eval records. No outcome-dependent selection.
shortage: If any rule yields fewer than 16, stop with INSUFFICIENT_ROOTS; do not expand ranges or relax criteria.
